integrity_statement: The proof separates classical geometric premises from exact finite-group and finite-field calculations. The included standalone verifier checks all 432 affine permutations and explicit characteristic-seven witnesses. No independent audit or externally certified novelty is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic greater than three; reduced twelve-line curve only. Ten spectral templates classify the affine actions, not existence of every template for each fixed finite field. Results derived from classical Hesse geometry and elementary affine-Galois theory; possible implicit appearances of the evaluated arithmetic spectra remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Point-free twists and nine zeta spectra of the Hesse twelve-line curve
